description: Defines SQLAlchemy ORM models for users, clients, leads, activities, and communications in a CRM system, including mixins and relationships.

classes.name: TimestampMixin
classes.description: Provides created_at and updated_at timestamp columns with automatic updates.

classes.name: User
classes.description: Represents a user with authentication info and relationships to clients, leads, activities, and communications.

classes.name: Client
classes.description: Represents a client/contact with personal info and relationships to activities and communications.

classes.name: Lead
classes.description: Represents a sales lead, optionally linked to a client, with status and value.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: Tracks tasks, meetings, calls, emails related to a client, with type, subject, due date, and description.

classes.name: Communication
classes.description: Records communications with a client via various channels, with subject and content.

methods.name: TimestampMixin
methods.description: Defines timestamp columns for creation and update times.

methods.name: User
methods.description: Defines user model with email, name, password, and relationships.

methods.name: Client
methods.description: Defines client model with contact info and relationships.

methods.name: Lead
methods.description: Defines lead model with status, value, and relationships.

methods.name: Activity
methods.description: Defines activity model with type, subject, due date, description, and relationships.

methods.name: Communication
methods.description: Defines communication model with channel, subject, content, and relationships.
